item.question: What is the expression for the AC Stark shift of the atomic ground state?
item.answer: The AC Stark shift of the atomic ground state is modeled as \( U(\boldsymbol{r}, \omega) = -\frac{\operatorname{Re}[\alpha(\omega)]}{2 \epsilon_{0} c} I(\boldsymbol{r}) \).
